regions.contentLimits: One brand link and one exit action on the stage color.
regions.overflow: Header actions wrap while the exit action stays reachable.

regions.contentLimits: One phone frame with one lead poster, four bundled scene choices, one personal-photo choice, one sentence, one alert, and two controls.
regions.overflow: The phone frame uses the available compact viewport and is capped at the phone container token on wide screens. Each picture crops to fill its tile.

responsive.compact: The frame fills the available viewport below the header and preserves its phone proportions.
responsive.wide: The frame stays centered at the phone container width.

focus.onOpen: The picture gallery is rendered in the stage and follows normal document focus order.
focus.onClose: Returning to the gallery keeps focus on the gallery control until the next picture is chosen.
focus.onError: Player, personal-photo, and sharing messages are announced without moving focus.

accessibility.headings: The immersive route has no visible page heading. The phone stage has a labelled section and all controls have labels.
accessibility.labels: Bundled scene buttons name the scene. The personal-photo button names its operation. A selected personal photo exposes its file name as alternative text.
accessibility.statusAnnouncements: Player, photo loading, and sharing failures use an alert.
